claim_scope: Fixed historical convenience-cohort paper-derived method control; not a Chan finding replication, causal aging estimate or population validation.

cohort.computational_order: subject_ids in the unchanged cohort manifest
cohort.selection: first60 pinned Nilearn index entries minus A00051882; inherited historical selection, not prospective QC

parcellation.roi_order: ascending annotation table index within hemisphere
parcellation.roi_identity: hemisphere + source annotation table index; preserve packed RGB identifiers separately

precision.parcel_mean: For ascending original vertex indices v within each hemisphere frame-by-vertex source X: np.asarray(X[:,v],dtype=np.float64,order='C').mean(axis=1,dtype=np.float64).astype(np.float32)
precision.amendment: prospective float64 accumulation replaces the old float32 intermediate reduction; no legacy-bit or partition-equivalence claim
precision.age: parse original phenotype number, np.float32 once, promote to np.float64
precision.evidence_rule: directed finite float32-neighbor interval around canonical parcel means and computational ages
precision.authoritative_basis: canonical source arithmetic, not accepted rounded evidence

connectivity.support: canonical exact-constant parcels have undefined correlations; no low-variance threshold
connectivity.group: Sequentially add each subject's canonical upper-triangle Fisher-z edge vector in manifest order; divide by59; mirror upper-triangle means into the lower triangle and set the diagonal to exactly0. This fixes incidental floating-point asymmetry before the public KMeans fit.
connectivity.group_support: all59 people required for every off-diagonal entry; no varying-cohort means

partition.input: 148x148 float64 C-order canonical group feature rows; no external row scaling; sample_weight=None
partition.equivalence: exact keyed ROI coassignment; arbitrary cluster-name bijection allowed
partition.less_than_seven: record actual fit; seven-network segregation undefined
partition.iteration_cap: retain capped returned result and captured warnings; n_iter==300 alone is not a rejection

summaries.within: sum(max(Fisher_z,0)) over all within-cluster pairs / full within pair count
summaries.between: sum(max(Fisher_z,0)) over all between-cluster pairs / full between pair count

age_endpoints.pearson: signed Pearson; two-sided default scipy1.14.1 pearsonr p
age_endpoints.interval_limits: plug-in independent-person approximation; does not propagate learned-partition uncertainty; clamp interval may not contain exact r=+/-1

output.undefined_npz: NaN only where canonical validity mask false
output.scoring: binary: complete authenticated numeric evidence passes1; failed/incomplete artifacts0; no proportional partial credit

tolerances.parcel_means_computational_age: directed immediate finite binary32 neighbors inclusive; finite real storage accepted
tolerances.natural_domains: see output_contract.md; field tolerance allowed outward at mathematical bounds except strict p[0,1], ages/counts; no Inf

source_facts_status: Authenticated structural inspection passed before functional Data payload decoding; functional finiteness/constancy remain to be evaluated under the frozen contract.
